name: The Ghost of Us
source:
As a medium, you're used to working with the dead. But when a ghost needs your help to solve their murder, will your growing feelings get in the way?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Ghost_of_Us]Choices Wikia[/url]]
